title: Notices
sheetDescription: Notices from your agency, your brand or the Hero Portal arrive here.
pageDescription: Everything that happened to you in the management portals.
emptyHint: When something needs you, it shows up here and on the bell.

brand_member_joined.title: New brand member
brand_member_joined.body: {name} now has access to the {brand} brand portal.

talent_consent_given.title: Consent recorded
talent_consent_given.body: {talent} authorized commercial use of their data.

talent_consent_revoked.title: Consent revoked
talent_consent_revoked.body: {talent} revoked commercial use of their data.

campaign_status_changed.title: {status, select, room_opened {Project room opened} feedback_requested {Tell us how it went} feedback_received {New client rating} clipping_ready {Project clipping ready} other {Campaign updated}}
campaign_status_changed.body: {status, select, room_opened {The room for {deal} is open: conversation, rules and shoot day in one place.} feedback_requested {Rate {deal} from 0 to 10.} feedback_received {The client rated {deal} {step}.} clipping_ready {{deal} is complete: see the clipping and usage guide.} other {{deal} changed status.}}

proposal_received.title: {status, select, accepted {Proposal accepted} countered {Agency counteroffer} other {Proposal received}}
proposal_received.body: {status, select, accepted {The agency accepted your proposal for {deal}. Terms agreed.} countered {The agency made a counteroffer for {deal}: accept, counter or decline.} other {The agency sent the proposal for {deal}.}}

proposal_decided.title: {status, select, accepted {Brand accepted} countered {Brand counteroffer} declined {Brand declined} other {Brand response}}
proposal_decided.body: {status, select, accepted {{brand} accepted the counteroffer for {deal}. Terms agreed.} countered {{brand} made a counteroffer for {deal}: reply.} declined {{brand} declined the counteroffer for {deal}.} other {{brand} answered the proposal for {deal}.}}

contract_acceptance_requested.title: Contract to accept
contract_acceptance_requested.body: The contract for {deal} is waiting for your acceptance.

task_assigned.title: New task
task_assigned.body: You have a new task in {deal}.

deliverable_published.title: {status, select, insights_24h {Send your 24 h insights} insights_7d {Send your 7-day insights} insights_late {Insights overdue} other {Content published}}
deliverable_published.body: {status, select, insights_24h {{title} for {deal} has been live for 24 h: send the screenshot and numbers (reach, views…).} insights_7d {{title} for {deal} was published 7 days ago: send the final numbers.} insights_late {{talent} hasn't sent the insights for {title} ({deal}) yet.} other {{talent} published the content for {deal}.}}

commercial_date_published.title: New commercial date
commercial_date_published.body: The agency published an opportunity for {date}.

relationship_alert.title: No contact for a while
relationship_alert.body: No one has talked to {talent} recently.

task_overdue.title: Overdue task
task_overdue.body: A task in {deal} is past its due date.

payout_updated.title: Payout updated
payout_updated.body: The payout for {deal} has a new status.

internal_approval_requested.title: {status, select, strategy_review {Strategy to review} other {Campaign to approve}}
internal_approval_requested.body: {status, select, strategy_review {{name} sent the idea “{title}” for Strategy to review.} other {{name} asked for approval of {campaign}.}}

internal_approval_decided.title: {status, select, strategy_approved {Strategy approved} strategy_returned {Strategy needs changes} other {Internal approval}}
internal_approval_decided.body: {status, select, strategy_approved {{name} approved “{title}”. Prepare the material and send it to the brand.} strategy_returned {{name} returned “{title}” with a note to adjust.} other {The director decided on {campaign}.}}

invoice_submitted.title: Invoice received
invoice_submitted.body: {talent} sent the invoice for {deal}. Review it and schedule the payment.

invoice_reviewed.title: {status, select, approve {Invoice approved} other {Invoice rejected}}
invoice_reviewed.body: {status, select, approve {The agency approved the invoice for {deal}.} other {The agency rejected the invoice for {deal}. See why and send a new one.}}

payout_scheduled.title: Payment scheduled
payout_scheduled.body: The agency scheduled the payment for {deal}. See the date in Earnings.

budget_exceeded.title: Budget exceeded
budget_exceeded.body: The hiring for {deal} went above the reserved budget.

usage_rights_expiring.title: {status, select, today {Usage rights expire today} other {Usage rights expiring}}
usage_rights_expiring.body: {status, select, today {Usage rights for content by {talent} in {deal} expire today ({date}).} other {Usage rights for content by {talent} in {deal} expire in {step} days ({date}).}}

deliverable_comment.title: Comment on a deliverable
deliverable_comment.body: {status, select, brand {The brand commented on a deliverable of {deal}.} other {The agency commented on a deliverable of {deal}.}}

task_due_soon.title: Deadline coming up
task_due_soon.body: A task in {deal} is due in less than 24 hours.

sponsorship_decided.title: Sponsorship decided
sponsorship_decided.body: {status, select, won {Your brand was chosen to sponsor {title}.} sponsored {{title} was sponsored by {brand}.} cancelled {The opportunity {title} was cancelled.} other {The opportunity {title} was closed.}}

sponsorship_negotiation.title: Sponsorship negotiation
sponsorship_negotiation.body: {status, select, proposed {{brand} made an offer for the {tier} tier of {title}.} countered {New counteroffer on the {tier} tier of {title}.} agreed {Sponsorship agreed: {tier} tier of {title}.} declined {The offer for the {tier} tier of {title} was declined.} closed {The {tier} tier of {title} was closed with another brand.} approval {The team prepared an offer for {title}: approve to send.} returned {The owner returned the offer for {title}.} approved {The owner approved and sent the offer for {title}.} other {News in the negotiation of {title}.}}

brand_call_negotiation.title: Proposal for a brand request
brand_call_negotiation.body: {status, select, proposed {{name} sent a proposal for {title}.} countered {New counteroffer on {title}.} agreed {Deal closed on {title}.} declined {The proposal for {title} was declined.} approval {The team prepared a reply on {title}: approve to send.} returned {The owner sent back your reply on {title}.} approved {The owner approved and sent your reply on {title}.} other {News on {title}.}}

brand_call_decided.title: Brand request decided
brand_call_decided.body: {status, select, won {Your proposal won on {title} ({brand}).} lost {{brand} chose another proposal on {title}.} chosen {You were chosen for {title} ({brand}).} cancelled {{brand} cancelled {title}.} other {{brand} closed {title}.}}

brand_call_review.title: Call to approve
brand_call_review.body: {status, select, requested {{name} asked to publish {title}.} returned {The owner sent {title} back for changes.} approved {The owner published {title}.} other {News on {title}.}}

budget_change.title: Budget change
budget_change.body: {status, select, review {Your team asked to change the budget of {deal}: review it and send it to the agency.} returned {The owner returned the budget request for {deal}.} sent {The owner sent the budget request for {deal} to the agency.} requested {The brand asked to change the budget of {deal}.} withdrawn {The brand withdrew the budget request for {deal}.} declined {The agency declined the budget request for {deal}. The current budget stays.} proposed {The agency agreed to review the budget of {deal} and proposed a realignment: the owner confirms or declines.} confirmed {The brand confirmed the new budget of {deal}. See the realignment tasks.} rejected {The brand declined the realignment of {deal}.} other {News on the budget request for {deal}.}}

payment_reported.title: Payment reported
payment_reported.body: {brand} reported a payment for {deal}. Check it and confirm receipt.

payment_reviewed.title: {status, select, confirmed {Payment confirmed} other {Payment not confirmed}}
payment_reviewed.body: {status, select, confirmed {The agency confirmed receiving the payment for {deal}.} other {The agency did not confirm the payment for {deal}. See why and report it again.}}

payment_due.title: {status, select, late {Payment overdue} today {Payment due today} other {Payment due soon}}
payment_due.body: {status, select, late {The payment for {deal} is overdue.} today {The payment for {deal} is due today.} other {The payment for {deal} is due within 3 days.}}

payment_plan.title: Payment installments
payment_plan.body: The agency split the payment for {deal} into {step} installment(s). See the due dates.

payout_due.title: {status, select, late {Payout overdue} today {Payout due today} other {Payout due soon}}
payout_due.body: {status, select, late {The payout for {deal} ({talent}) is overdue.} today {The payout for {deal} ({talent}) is due today.} other {The payout for {deal} ({talent}) is due within 3 days.}}

hero_account_linked.title: Your hero account is ready
hero_account_linked.body: {name} registered {talent} and linked it to your account. Open the Hero Portal.

brand_access_granted.title: You are the Owner of {brand}
brand_access_granted.body: {name} registered {brand} and gave you Owner access. Open the brand portal.
